observations.detail: Embedded PDF Bengali letters, Arabic characters/digits and diacritics differ from displayed glyphs. For example v2 p3 visibly prints Bengali ১/৯৯৮ and Arabic ٩٩٨/١ while raw PDF text extraction contains 999 for Arabic numeral. Do not silently use PDF embedded text as verbatim authority.

Four unnumbered Bengali cited-report occurrences inside author preface: Muslim2699, Ibn Hibban without a number, Muslim2674, and quotation attributed to Ali with Bukhari3701/Muslim2406. Keep source attribution and do not reclassify without verification.
Final page contains continuation and Bengali occurrence ২/৯৯৭, then a separate starred explanatory paragraph and footnote990.
Begins Book 8 kitāb al-faḍāʾil, chapter180, Bengali occurrence ১/৯৯৮; following Arabic occurrence ٩٩٩/٢ also begins on page.

Appendix headed রিয়াদুস সালেহীন গ্রন্থের যঈফ (দুর্বল) হাদীসের তালিকা contains Bengali hadith excerpts and alleged problematic narrators in a table. These are distinct printed occurrences and attributed grading claims, not automatic verified grades. Preserve rows separately and link related main occurrences without deduplication.
Continuation observed all original TOC pages957–1021,394 table rows and375 generated Bengali labels. Exhaustive table-character/diacritic equivalence remains uncertified.
Colophon explicitly names renewed reviewer Dr Abu Bakr Muhammad Zakaria and dated review night14 Shaban1434AH; exact DOC text agrees with original PDF image.
Chapter-index page-number column headed পৃষ্ঠা is printed blank in the observed images, not an extraction omission.
Narrator cell is literally truncated র ইবনু হাওশাব and hadith excerpt ends &. DOC and image agree; do not silently repair.
The appendix row explicitly attributes text to Imam Shafii (রাহিমাহুল্লাহ), not directly to the Prophet. Preserve that attribution despite appendix heading.
